title: ChatBubbleHead
description: Chat bubbles like the QSMP Server.
body:
# 💬 ChatBubbleHead

> Turn your server's chat into an immersive visual experience.

**ChatBubbleHead** displays chat messages directly above each player’s head, 
as floating bubbles—just like in QSMP.

## ✨ What does it do?

Every time a player types in the chat, an animated text bubble appears 
floating above their head, visible to all nearby players.
- 🎨 **Fully customizable** — HEX colors, opacity, size, duration
- 🔁 **Smooth animations** — native pop-in and pop-out effects
- 📦 **Smart stacking** — multiple messages without overlapping
- 🙈 **Per-player toggle** — each player decides whether to see or show their bubbles
- 🚗 **Mount support** — works on horses, camels, and more
- 💾 **Persistence** — preferences are saved across restarts

## ⚙️ Commands
| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/chatbubble` | Turn your chat bubbles on or off |
| `/chatbubble reload` | Reload the settings |
| `/chatbubble global` | Global toggle (admins only) |ggle global (solo admins) |
## 📋 Requirements
- **Paper 1.20.2 – 1.21.11** (or Purpur)
- Java 21
